description:
Cheating Wife’s Erotic Stories is a captivating collection of tales exploring passion, desire, and human intimacy. Each story delves into forbidden connections and the hidden emotions that ignite where they’re least expected. The collection invites readers into a world of secret fantasies, simmering tension, and temptation, where the line between longing and betrayal becomes dangerously thin.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/an_ill_advisde_book?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13227763), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587013293), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/yaseolbogam), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8869)
